$comment: Research data behind the etherscan-compatible entries of the routing table (decision 0039). It does not ship. The candidates are the chains whose etherscanApiUrl in alloy-chains 0.2.39 (assets/chains.json, Foundry's chain list) names a host of its own that is not Etherscan, Routescan or Blockscout, and that issue #170 names. On 2026-11-05 each API was sent the keyless request in request. hosts holds the APIs that answered as Etherscan does; scripts/routing-seed.ts reads them through scripts/routing-etherscan-compatible.ts. leftOut holds the APIs that refused the request without a key: they get an entry only after a run with a key.
